lines.zh: 刺尾鱼贴着海草游，一株一株看过去
lines.en: I glide past the seagrass, plant by plant.

lines.zh: 尾刺一摆，刺尾鱼又往前一截
lines.en: A flick of my tail spine carries me forward.

lines.zh: 礁盘上路线固定，刺尾鱼天天走
lines.en: The reef routes are fixed; I take them daily.

lines.zh: 四只刺尾鱼排成一线，游得整齐
lines.en: Four of us in a line, swimming neat.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝间只留窄缝，刺尾鱼钻得巧
lines.en: Only a slit between corals, and I thread it.

lines.zh: 水草摆向哪边，刺尾鱼就往哪拐
lines.en: Where the weeds lean, I turn.

lines.zh: 海草床边缘有空地，刺尾鱼绕过去
lines.en: There's a clearing at the bed's edge; I skirt it.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼游得急，尾刺在水里划线
lines.en: Swimming fast, my spine draws a line in water.

lines.zh: 同伴在前，刺尾鱼跟着不掉队
lines.en: My school is ahead and I keep pace.

lines.zh: 礁石挡路，刺尾鱼从侧面绕
lines.en: A rock blocks me; I go around the side.

lines.zh: 海草密处难游，刺尾鱼偏要走
lines.en: The thick weeds are hard going, so of course I take them.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼一顿一顿地游，边走边吃
lines.en: I swim in stops and starts, eating as I go.

lines.zh: 光斑移动，刺尾鱼跟着影子走
lines.en: The light spots shift and I follow the shade.

lines.zh: 一群刺尾鱼齐刷刷转向，很整齐
lines.en: The whole school turns at once, and it's lovely.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼贴着珊瑚枝，一寸寸挪
lines.en: The surgeonfish inches along the coral branch.

lines.zh: 水流一变，刺尾鱼立刻掉头
lines.en: The current shifts and the surgeonfish turns at once.

lines.zh: 沙地上有碎藻，刺尾鱼停下来捡
lines.en: Scraps of algae on the sand; the surgeonfish stops to pick them.

lines.zh: 两条刺尾鱼擦身过，尾刺差点碰上
lines.en: Two surgeonfish pass close; their tail spines almost touch.

lines.zh: 礁洞里黑，刺尾鱼还是照直游进去
lines.en: The reef hole is dark; the surgeonfish swims straight in.

lines.zh: 浪推过来，刺尾鱼顺着浪滑一段
lines.en: A wave pushes in and the surgeonfish rides it a while.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼悬在水草上方，慢慢嚼
lines.en: I hover over the weeds, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 吃完一株，刺尾鱼停着消化
lines.en: One plant done; I pause to digest.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁午后安静，刺尾鱼也安静
lines.en: The reef is quiet at midday, and so am I.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼尾巴轻摆，维持着位置
lines.en: My tail flicks lightly, holding my place.

lines.zh: 同伴都散了，刺尾鱼独自发呆
lines.en: The school scattered and I stare at nothing.

lines.zh: 海草在嘴边晃，刺尾鱼懒得张口
lines.en: Weeds sway by my mouth; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼把尾刺收好，免得扎到邻居
lines.en: I fold my spine away so I don't stab a neighbor.

lines.zh: 光从水面落下来，刺尾鱼不动
lines.en: Light falls from above and I hold still.

lines.zh: 这片海草床够吃很久，我很安心
lines.en: This bed will feed us a long while; I relax.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼打个嗝，吐出一点草屑
lines.en: I burp up a fleck of weed.

lines.zh: 礁盘边水声很轻，刺尾鱼听着
lines.en: The reef edge murmurs and I listen.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼悬停着，鳍像小扇子
lines.en: Hovering, my fins work like little fans.

lines.zh: 水草又长高了，刺尾鱼仰头看
lines.en: The weeds have grown tall; I look up at them.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼想歇，又怕同伴走远
lines.en: I want to rest but fear the school moving on.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼歪头看你，嘴里还叼着草
lines.en: I tilt at you, weed still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你踩在礁盘上，刺尾鱼绕开你
lines.en: You stand on the reef flat; I circle wide.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼盯你的手，怕你抓鱼
lines.en: I watch your hands, afraid you'll grab fish.

lines.zh: 你离海草太近了，刺尾鱼有点急
lines.en: You're too close to the weeds and I fret.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼抬眼一瞬，又低头吃草
lines.en: I glance up, then go back to grazing.

lines.zh: 你身后好几只刺尾鱼在偷看
lines.en: Several of my school peek from behind you.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，刺尾鱼往草里躲
lines.en: Such a shadow; I slip into the weeds.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼认得出你，昨天也来过
lines.en: I know you; you came yesterday too.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，刺尾鱼就游近一点
lines.en: You crouch and I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 尾刺对着你，刺尾鱼只是习惯
lines.en: My spine points your way out of habit.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼被咬掉半片鳍
lines.en: Half a fin gone in one bite.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，同伴全跑了
lines.en: Blood clouds the water and the school bolts.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼疼得乱窜，撞上珊瑚
lines.en: I bolt in pain and hit the coral.

lines.zh: 才三点血，刺尾鱼撑不了多久
lines.en: Only three hearts; I won't last long.

lines.zh: 尾刺断了，刺尾鱼更慌了
lines.en: My spine snapped and I panic.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼躲进草里，抖个不停
lines.en: I hide in the weeds, shaking.

lines.zh: 这一口让刺尾鱼记住了
lines.en: That bite left a memory.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼翻身游，身子歪了
lines.en: I swim flipped, body crooked.

lines.zh: 伤口碰到海水，刺尾鱼抽气
lines.en: Saltwater hits the wound and I gasp.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼游不动了，悬在原地
lines.en: I can't swim; I just hang there.

lines.zh: 你手里有海草，刺尾鱼眼睛亮了
lines.en: You hold seagrass and my eyes brighten.

lines.zh: 那株草看着嫩，刺尾鱼想尝
lines.en: That blade looks tender; I want a taste.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼游过来，围着你的手转
lines.en: I swim over and circle your hand.

lines.zh: 同伴先冲了，刺尾鱼赶紧跟上
lines.en: A schoolmate darts first; I follow.

lines.zh: 有吃的就顾不得怕了
lines.en: With food around, fear doesn't stand a chance.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼张嘴等着，尾巴摆得快
lines.en: Mouth open, I wait, tail beating fast.

lines.zh: 你把草按在水里，刺尾鱼一口咬住
lines.en: You pin the weed down and I bite it.

lines.zh: 闻起来是海草床的味道
lines.en: It smells like home, the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 再给一株，刺尾鱼就不走了
lines.en: One more blade and I'm staying.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼吃相不雅，你别笑
lines.en: My table manners are poor; don't laugh.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼被挤得侧翻，尾刺差点扎人
lines.en: Squeezed into a tilt, my spine nearly pokes someone.

lines.zh: 一群鱼撞成一团，乱成一锅
lines.en: The school bumps into a knot, all in a jumble.

lines.zh: 你碰了礁石，刺尾鱼跟着晃
lines.en: You nudged the reef and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼让路慢了一拍
lines.en: I gave way a beat too late.

lines.zh: 尾刺蹭到你，刺尾鱼赶紧退开
lines.en: My spine brushes you and I back off fast.

lines.zh: 海草丛太密，刺尾鱼撞得草屑乱飞
lines.en: In the thick weeds I scatter bits everywhere.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼被撞开，又游回队里
lines.en: Knocked aside, I swim back into formation.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，刺尾鱼也没地方躲
lines.en: Don't crowd me; there's nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 这一撞把刺尾鱼的队形打散了
lines.en: The bump scatters our formation.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼滑了一下，鳍翅收了收
lines.en: I slip, fins tucking in.

lines.zh: 珊瑚硬，刺尾鱼软，撞了吃亏
lines.en: Coral is hard, I am soft; the coral wins.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼绕开你，尾刺还竖着
lines.en: I go around you, spine still raised.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼找块干净礁石，摆好姿势
lines.en: I find a clean rock and strike a pose.

lines.zh: 同伴靠过来，两条尾刺轻轻碰
lines.en: My mate drifts near; our spines touch lightly.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼绕着对方转圈，转得很规矩
lines.en: I circle my mate in perfect order.

lines.zh: 海草床边缘是最好的产卵场
lines.en: The seagrass edge is the finest spawning ground.

lines.zh: 一群刺尾鱼同时起舞，水都亮了
lines.en: The whole school dances and the water brightens.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼挑伴侣，看谁吃得最干净
lines.en: I choose the mate who grazes the tidiest.

lines.zh: 两条鱼并排啃草，算是一次约会
lines.en: Two fish grazing side by side: that's a date.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼守着自己那片草等它
lines.en: I guard my patch of weeds and wait.

lines.zh: 繁殖季到了，刺尾鱼颜色都艳了
lines.en: Breeding season comes and my colors deepen.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼答应得快，游得也快
lines.en: I agree quickly and swim off just as fast.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼叼起一截海草，省得再啃
lines.en: I snatch a weed strand to save chewing.

lines.zh: 掉下来的珊瑚屑，刺尾鱼捡走
lines.en: A coral crumb falls and I take it.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞着草，刺尾鱼还要再拿
lines.en: Weed in mouth, I still grab another.

lines.zh: 这枚螺壳亮，刺尾鱼藏进礁缝
lines.en: This shell is bright; I stash it in a crevice.

lines.zh: 同伴掉的草叶，刺尾鱼捡起来吃
lines.en: A schoolmate drops a leaf and I eat it.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼把石子推到窝边
lines.en: I push a pebble to my nest.

lines.zh: 捡东西也要排队，刺尾鱼等着
lines.en: Even collecting has a queue; I wait.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼衔着草游，像举着旗
lines.en: Carrying weed, I look like I hold a flag.

lines.zh: 沉底的碎屑，刺尾鱼一片片收
lines.en: Sinking scraps, I gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 别抢，这根是刺尾鱼的
lines.en: Don't grab it; this strand is mine.

lines.zh: 一株嫩草晃了晃，刺尾鱼看中它
lines.en: A tender blade sways and I pick it out.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼盯住那片水草，尾刺竖起
lines.en: I fix on that weed patch, spine rising.

lines.zh: 目标不是猎物，是今天的早饭
lines.en: My target isn't prey; it's breakfast.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼锁定最密的那丛草
lines.en: I lock onto the thickest clump.

lines.zh: 同伴都往那边游，那儿有好东西
lines.en: The school heads that way, so something's good there.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼看准了，就等水草摆低
lines.en: I've chosen; now I wait for it to dip.

lines.zh: 那片草被影子盖住，刺尾鱼记下位置
lines.en: Shadow covers the patch; I note where it is.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼定住不动，眼睛却很快
lines.en: I hold still, though my eyes are quick.

lines.zh: 目标太远，刺尾鱼先记着
lines.en: Too far, so I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 这一丛够全队吃，刺尾鱼宣布
lines.en: This clump feeds the school, I declare.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼冲过去，一口咬住草尖
lines.en: I dart in and bite the tip.

lines.zh: 水草太韧，刺尾鱼扯了半天
lines.en: The weed is tough and I tug and tug.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼追着一片漂走的草叶
lines.en: I chase a leaf drifting away.

lines.zh: 同伴围上来，草丛一下秃了
lines.en: The school crowds in and the clump goes bare.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼边吃边看，怕鲨鱼来
lines.en: I eat with one eye out for sharks.

lines.zh: 草根扎得深，刺尾鱼拽不动
lines.en: The roots hold firm; I can't pull them.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼钻进水草丛，外面看不见它
lines.en: I burrow into the weeds and vanish.

lines.zh: 这一口咬空了，刺尾鱼很没面子
lines.en: I bite empty water and lose face.

lines.zh: 目标换了一丛，刺尾鱼立刻转身
lines.en: I switch clumps and turn at once.

lines.zh: 吃到一半，刺尾鱼想起该走了
lines.en: Halfway through I remember I should go.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼甩尾，尾刺划过去
lines.en: I whip my tail and the spine slashes past.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但很扎人
lines.en: The blow is light, but it stings.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼撞进鱼群，把水搅乱
lines.en: I barge into the school and churn the water.

lines.zh: 尾刺擦过对方，刺尾鱼自己先躲
lines.en: The spine grazes and I flinch first.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼咬一口就跑，草食鱼的本事
lines.en: I bite once and flee, a grazer's tactic.

lines.zh: 打不过就成群上，刺尾鱼懂
lines.en: Can't win alone, so we swarm; I know that.

lines.zh: 这一撞，带着一股海草味
lines.en: This hit comes with a taste of seagrass.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼尾刺竖得笔直，装凶
lines.en: Spine straight up, I pretend to be fierce.

lines.zh: 对方退了，刺尾鱼还在抖
lines.en: It retreated, and I'm still trembling.

lines.zh: 别逼刺尾鱼，它只会这一招
lines.en: Don't corner me; this is my only move.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁亮了一下，刺尾鱼来了
lines.en: The reef brightens and here I am.

lines.zh: 这窝四只，刺尾鱼排成一排
lines.en: Four of us this spawn, lined up.

lines.zh: 海草床多了几条小影子
lines.en: The seagrass bed gains a few small shadows.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼刚出生就找草吃
lines.en: I look for weeds the moment I'm born.

lines.zh: 水流把刺尾鱼推进礁盘
lines.en: The current nudges me onto the reef flat.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼睁眼，先认同伴
lines.en: I open my eyes and learn my school first.

lines.zh: 新来的刺尾鱼贴着礁石走
lines.en: The new surgeonfish hug the rocks.

lines.zh: 这片礁盘又归刺尾鱼巡逻了
lines.en: This flat is under surgeonfish patrol again.

lines.zh: 刺尾鱼摆尾，试着跟上队伍
lines.en: I flick my tail, trying to join the line.

lines.zh: 一窝刺尾鱼同时转头，挺整齐
lines.en: A whole spawn turns together, quite neat.

lines.zh: 水变烫了，刺尾鱼往礁缝里钻
lines.en: The water heats up and I dive into a crevice.

lines.zh: 摔在礁石上，刺尾鱼弹起来
lines.en: Landing on rock, I bounce.

lines.zh: 离开水，刺尾鱼的鳃抽得厉害
lines.en: Out of water my gills work frantically.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，水草全被掀翻
lines.en: A blast flips the seagrass over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水，刺尾鱼侧身躲开一半
lines.en: An arrow parts the water; I dodge half of it.

lines.zh: 药水味怪，刺尾鱼鳞片发紧
lines.en: The potion smells wrong and my scales tighten.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，刺尾鱼饿得发慌
lines.en: The weeds are gone and I'm frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅礁，刺尾鱼被震晕
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and stuns me.

lines.zh: 礁盘下空了，刺尾鱼一直往下掉
lines.en: The reef drops away and I keep falling.
